observations.inspectedFrom: Image in the first post of the Elite Fourum thread 51087 (2024-11-05), where a collector asks for the Japanese "Wild Blaze/Flashfire non-Holo UED (066/080)" and later reports buying it (post 6, 2025-07-30)
observations.observed: Complete legible face of the Japanese XY2 Snorlax: カビゴン HP130, Ability にどね, attack たおれこみプレス 120, Illus. Mitsuhiro Arita, ©2014, 066/080 U with the XY2 mark. The edition-mark position at lower left, below にげる, is visibly empty; no 1st Edition mark is printed.

physicalObservation.basis: Edition: the complete, legible face shows an empty 1st Edition mark position at lower left, so this copy is Unlimited. Finish: the post captions the pictured card "Japanese Wild Blaze/Flashfire non-Holo UED (066/080)" (UED = Unlimited Edition), and the artwork shows no foil.
